Note: What each shipped SystemEnergyCentre template can do, so that choosing one never costs the one to
two megabytes the template itself weighs. This file is read at runtime; the templates are not.
Entries are keyed on the EXISTING SystemTemplate identity. No new system or equipment identity is
introduced here - in particular there is no MVHR, because MVRE already is SAM's heat-recovery
ventilation and a second name would split one concept in two.
Only the ventilation identity is stated. These ten files are ventilation templates; heating, cooling,
plant room and controls are chosen elsewhere and do not select among them.
Rank is the preference order among systems that all meet a requirement - LOWER IS PREFERRED. It is a
policy about this library, which is why it lives here and not in SAM.Analytical. The order below is
DOMESTIC-BEFORE-COMMERCIAL, then unconditioned last - NOT simplest-first, which an earlier draft
claimed and the numbers contradict (CAV has fewer capabilities than MVRE yet ranks after it, and UV has
none at all yet ranks last). The order is PROPOSED, not confirmed: Michal to review.
Application is documentation only and is not a capability. It exists because CapableSystems reports
every suitable system to a caller who may apply its own policy, and nothing else would tell that caller
that CAV, VAV and DISP are commercial air-handling types rather than dwelling systems. Whether it should
become a real selection axis is Michal's call.
EvidenceFromTemplate names the capabilities whose value was established by reading the template file
itself, and which SystemEnergyCentreCapabilityTests re-verifies against the shipped resources. Every
other value is DECLARED from the system type's meaning in SAM_SystemTypeLibrary.JSON and is an
engineering statement to be confirmed, not a measurement.
SummerBypass is false everywhere, and that is a finding rather than an omission: no shipped template
models a summer bypass. Iteration 2 needs one, and until a template provides it a scenario requiring
bypass will be REFUSED - loudly, which is the point. Declaring it true would credit a dwelling with
mitigation the design does not have.

Templates.Description: Supply And Extract Mechanical Ventilation, no heat recovery
Mechanical Ventilation with heat recovery - SAM's MVHR. Exchanger 1, sensible 0.7, latent 0, no recirculation component.
Constant Air Volume. Boost false because the type is constant volume.
Displacement Ventilation. Boost false because raising the supply rate breaks the displacement regime.
Unconditioned. Provides nothing, so it is never suitable - it is listed so the library is complete rather than silently short of a file.

NonVentilationResources.Description: A plant room with no ventilation system type. Not a ventilation template, so it is never a candidate - recorded here so that every shipped resource is accounted for and none is silently missing an entry.
